hooks.command: jq -c '(.tool_input.file_path // "") as $f | ((.tool_input.content // .tool_input.new_string) // "") as $c | if ($f | test("(^|/)[.]changeset/[^/]+[.]md$")) and (($c | test("(?m)^\"?[^:\\n]+\"?\\s*:\\s*(minor|major)\\s*$")) or ($c | test("(?m)^(minor|major)$"))) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:"Changeset declares a minor/major bump. Repo policy is patch by default — approve only if a non-patch bump was explicitly requested."}} else empty end'
